methods.name: Post-event coherence increase (PECI)
methods.summary: A method that measures the increase in coherence between a co-event interferogram and a post-event interferogram, using histogram matching to account for bulk temporal decorrelation, to identify landslide pixels.
methods.verbatim: We also present three new methods which incorporate a second post-event image... the post-event coherence increase (PECI)... Applying the same histogram-matching step as in the CECL method, we propose this co-event-to-post-event coherence increase as a new potential landslide detection method.
